This is a channel promoting the business "Synergy in Motion", run by Dr. Coleen Johnston. She has been a licensed veterinarian since 2001, and is certified in animal chiropractic. This channel mainly consists of videos to help you understand the more complex information on how to take care of horses, such as through muscle exercises.
_____________

Look at our website for any information on Synergy In Motion:
https://www.equinesynergyinmotion.com/

Follow me on Facebook for content about stretches:
